d:
A dark fantasy design featuring long, flowing raven-black hair and piercing dark eyes. The outfit consists of minimal black leather armor, including spiked shoulder pauldrons, matching gauntlets, and a simple black bikini-style set paired with a rustic brown leather belt. The look is completed with intricate black swirling tattoos across the torso and thighs, and a sleek, clean-shaven face.
